checkedAlternates.risk: Registers and L1 cache are both inside the CPU.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A register is a single-word CPU storage slot (group-1), distinct from multi-kilobyte SRAM caches (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: VRAM sits on a graphics card rather than the motherboard.
checkedAlternates.resolution: GDDR6 VRAM is volatile dynamic RAM (group-3), whereas L1/L2 caches are on-die SRAM (group-2).
